floor.what: the organisers' floor: the reference's 10% working copy (copy_last or wt_identity)

fgw_polar.what: fgw with every cell moved by its k nearest anchors' least-squares local linear map, interpolated along its polar factors (rotation by the fraction of its angle, stretch linearly); the entry's mean move where the map is a reflection, degenerate or not finite

fgw_aligned_polar_series.what: fgw_aligned_series (the second upload as built) with fgw_polar's polar move
fgw_aligned_polar_series.rule: series: the shallower bracket's drawn cells are moved by a per-gene factor and then to the deeper bracket's depth (RENDER_RULE, hi). The factor is the T3 script's gene_factor over the cell-type labels that both brackets hold by name with at least SERIES_MIN_CELLS cells each and that are extraembryonic (a name starting with EXE-, or the lineage group ExtraEmbryonicMeso): the ratio of the two brackets' share-weighted mean within-cell panel proportions, weights the shallower bracket's label shares, eps 1e-5, rescaled so the weighted total proportion is unchanged, clipped to 0.25-4. It is applied in count space (binomial thinning below 1, Poisson top-up from the cell's kNN-smoothed proportions above 1). The deeper bracket's cells stay as released

fgw_polar_frame.what: fgw_polar with the patch's whole affine map of the common frame (translation included) interpolated along its polar factors, instead of the offset from the patch centroid
